job_title: Senior Data Analyst | Power BI Data & Analytics Specialist
job_description:
Leverage data analytics skills, BI technologies, and best practices to transform raw data into actionable business insights, enabling informed decision-making and enhancing data readability for stakeholders.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Requirement Analysis & Solution Design: Conduct stakeholder sessions to gather requirements and design BI solutions using BI stack.
Data Extraction & Transformation: Extract data from SQL, SAP BW, Oracle, and other systems. Cleanse, transform, and optimize data for accuracy and usability.
BI Development & Governance: Develop Power BI dashboards and reports adhering to best practices. Monitor system logs, enforce data access controls, and refine user roles.
Data Quality & Integrity: Collaborate with data owners to define data quality standards and ensure compliance. Perform data validation, profiling, and quality assessments.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Maintain clear communication with stakeholders, ensuring alignment on deliverables. Support data governance initiatives to enhance integrity, availability, and reliability.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, or a related field.
7+ years in data analysis, BI development, or data modeling.
Advanced SQL & Python for data extraction and manipulation.
Power BI expertise (dashboard development, DAX, data modeling).
Database design, ETL processes, and data warehousing.
Data mining, segmentation, and statistical analysis.
Data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication (written & verbal) and stakeholder management.
Ability to present insights effectively through reports and presentations.
Collaborative team player with cross-functional experience.
